content.en: The **International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD)** was established in 1977 as a result of the 1974 World Food Conference. It operates as a **specialized agency of the United Nations** and an **international financial institution**. Its primary focus is to empower rural poor people in developing countries to increase their food production and nutrition.
content.hi: The **International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD)** was established in 1977 as a result of the 1974 World Food Conference. It operates as a **specialized agency of the United Nations** and an **international financial institution**. Its primary focus is to empower rural poor people in developing countries to increase their food production and nutrition.

definition.en: IFAD provides low-interest loans and grants to finance innovative agricultural and rural development projects.
definition.hi: IFAD provides low-interest loans and grants to finance innovative agricultural and rural development projects.

content.en: India is a founding member of IFAD and has been a significant recipient of its assistance for various rural development and tribal empowerment projects.

content.en: Do not confuse IFAD with the FAO (Food and Agriculture Organization); while they collaborate, IFAD is specifically a financial institution.

content.en: Focus on how IFAD's projects align with India's Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) related to hunger and poverty.
